authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL nakha subsection 2 nakkha explicitly gives Bshk nakh, Savi nakē and Torwali nōkh. Selected Bshk naī̃k/nūk/nāk and Mai nākh forms follow that regional branch; Oriya no.kʰo and Vasavi nakhõ are provisionally grouped with the retained velar-aspirate family. Source nasalization, vowels, h loss or retention and punctuation remain intact; local transmission and the historical geminate are qualified. The complete repeated-form slash response is preserved. Longer -ḍo/-ḍio nail forms remain separate. Exact response: naī̃k.
